resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code; public download and installation.

resources.notes: Primary DFT engine for supercell relaxations and NEB calculations.

resources.name: Pseudopotentials for U and O

access.notes: Standard PAW or ultrasoft pseudopotentials suitable for LDA+U or GGA+U calculations with U (5f) and O; obtainable from public libraries (e.g., SSSP, PSLibrary, or the Quantum ESPRESSO site).

resources.notes: Choose pseudopotentials for U (5f electrons) and O; the paper used PAW with LDA+U (U=4.5 eV, J=0.51 eV).

resources.name: UO2 crystal structure

access.notes: Fluorite structure (space group Fm-3m) with experimental lattice constant a = 5.47 Å. The unit cell can be generated from standard crystallographic data; no external file required.

resources.notes: Used to construct the 2×2×3 supercell for defect calculations.
